FxDAO Vaults (testnet) - own build of FxDAO's real open-source vaults contract (FxDAO/FxDAO-SC v0.6.0, not a stub), fully owned with its own oracle and usd stablecoin so the integration suite can self-provision a fresh vault position every run; FxDAO's own testnet and mainnet vaults are both confirmed unusable (see verifiedBy)
entries.verifiedBy: 2026-09-28: built github.com/FxDAO/FxDAO-SC (main, vaults v0.6.0) via stellar contract build, deployed to testnet with a fresh admin-controlled oracle and usd stablecoin; a real vault opened and closed end to end via this adapter's pay_debt call, collateral returned atomically on full repayment. FxDAO's own testnet vault still has no ledger entry; its mainnet vault still exposes only evict/upgrade; founder confirmed the protocol stopped, matching DeFiLlama's Stellar TVL at $0 since 2026-05-20

entries.label: Phoenix XYK pool (testnet) - own redeploy of live_xlm_usdc_pool.wasm, genuinely initialized (not just a bytecode reference) with a custom SEP-41 test token so the integration suite can provide and withdraw real liquidity every run; interface confirmed to still expose withdraw_liquidity via stellar contract info interface
